purpose: Enter or edit information and save it.
layout: A clear title, then labelled fields grouped into 2–3 short sections, each field with a label above and helper text where needed. The save button stays reachable at the bottom.

required: Title stating what is being created or edited
optional: Pickers (date, category) instead of free text
Inline validation message on one field

primaryAction.note: Full-width filled button at the bottom, labelled with the verb ("Create habit").

avoid: Placeholder text as the only label
One long ungrouped column of 10 fields

variants.layout: Stacked sections: labelled fields grouped into 2–3 titled sections, save button at the bottom.
Inset rows: settings-style grouped rows where each row opens or holds a value (label left, value right), plus one text area.
Stepped: a progress indicator at the top showing step 1 of 3, only this step's fields below, Continue at the bottom.
